description: This file contains utility functions and configuration for extension test plan resolution, batch planning, and sharding in a testing framework. It manages extension directories, counts test files, merges test plans, and creates test shards for parallel execution.

methods.name: resolveExtensionTestPlan
methods.description: Resolves and returns a test plan for a specific extension or plugin directory, including test file count and configuration.

methods.name: mergeTestPlans
methods.description: Merges multiple individual extension test plans into a single aggregated plan.

methods.name: resolveExtensionBatchPlan
methods.description: Resolves test plans for multiple extensions and merges them into a batch plan.

methods.name: pickLeastLoadedShard
methods.description: Selects the shard with the least load (fewest test files) for balanced distribution.

methods.name: createExtensionTestShards
methods.description: Splits extensions' test plans into multiple shards for parallel testing execution.
